description: This file manages a set of cameraDevice objects, providing functions to create, destroy, clear, append, iterate, find by UUID or IP address, move between sets, and count camera devices. It includes thread safety via mutex locking and handles internal cleanup of cameraDevice objects.

methods.name: createCameraSet
methods.description: Creates and returns a new cameraSet object.

methods.name: destroyCameraSet
methods.description: Destroys a cameraSet and its contained cameraDevice objects, with thread safety.

methods.name: clearCameraSet
methods.description: Clears all cameraDevice objects from a set without destroying the set itself.

methods.name: appendCameraToSet
methods.description: Adds a cameraDevice to a set with thread safety.

methods.name: cameraSetIterate
methods.description: Iterates over each cameraDevice in the set, applying a callback function.

methods.name: findCameraByUuid
methods.description: Finds and returns a cameraDevice by its UUID.

methods.name: findCameraByIpAddress
methods.description: Finds and returns a cameraDevice by its IP address.

methods.name: destroyCameraDeviceFromSet
methods.description: Removes and destroys a cameraDevice identified by UUID from the set.

methods.name: moveCameraDeviceToSet
methods.description: Moves a cameraDevice from one set to another by UUID.

methods.name: cameraSetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of cameraDevice objects in a set.
